review_priorities.pattern_or_capability: Official detail acquisition and product/menu price-role separation
review_priorities.rationale: Tests a reusable official-detail pattern while preserving two materially different commerce contexts.
Negative boundary evidence is valuable for safe technique selection but must not be mistaken for technique failure.
Dependency-aware gap claims should be reviewed before higher-level transfer synthesis.
Review after source branches so synthesis cannot outrun the authority of its underlying evidence.
Review last because it depends on every source and transfer-matrix disposition.
